title: Why do you feel so happy after a workout? 😊
caption:
Newer studies point to endocannabinoids, feel-good chemicals your body makes during exercise that reach the brain easily. Endorphins are too big to easily get into the brain from the blood. Moderate steady effort works great. What is your post-gym mood? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #17
first_comment: Rate your post-workout mood from 1 to 10 👇
